items.briefing:
Ransomware attacks are becoming faster and harder to defend against, with cybercriminals now using AI tools to speed up their operations. This means Australian organisations like ours have less time to detect and respond to an attack before serious damage occurs. Staff should be extra cautious about suspicious emails or unexpected file activity on their devices.

There are also growing concerns around "shadow AI" — staff using unauthorised AI tools at work without IT approval. This can expose sensitive organisational data. **Practical tip:** Only use AI tools that have been approved by your organisation, and check with your manager or IT team before trying a new one.

featured.title: Ransomware attacks speed up as hackers use AI tools
featured.quote: AI-accelerated ransomware attacks threaten Australian manufacturers with faster intrusions and harder defenses.
